footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Skydance: includes a $305M income tax benefit, $14.0M from discontinued operations; after $291M of equity in loss of investee companies, ne, $41.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2024 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.5% to $29.2B in 2025. The operating loss widened to $5.3B from $451M.
The net loss widened to $6.2B, or −$9.34 per share, from $608M. Operating cash flow was $752M and free cash flow $489M, versus $147M; Skydance returned $139M through dividends.
